services.notes: perplexity.ai/pricing returned HTTP 404 and the help-centre pricing articles contain no amounts, so USD web prices come from Finout's dated report (2026-04-27, 'correct as of April 2026'): Pro $20/mo or $200/yr, Max $200/mo or $2,000/yr. Perplexity's own blog (2025-07-02) also states Pro $20/month. iOS prices from App Store In-App Purchases lists; item names do not state the cycle, so the lower 'Perplexity Pro' price is mapped to monthly and the ~10x price to yearly (matching the web monthly/annual ratio), and 'Perplexity Max' to monthly. Philippines storefront lists two different Pro monthly prices (PHP 1,290 and 999) so PH monthly is omitted. Web billing is USD so non-US web prices omitted.

services.name: PlayStation Plus
services.notes: US prices read from playstation.com/en-us. Regional playstation.com pages (GB, DE, MY, ID, SG, AE, AU, CA) show prices only after sign-in; PH page says PS Plus is not available there. services.name: Runway
services.notes: runway.com/pricing (USD worldwide) shows the yearly toggle by default: Standard $12/mo (struck-through $15), Pro $28/mo ($35), Max $76/mo ($95), '-20% off' yearly. Monthly plans use the struck-through monthly-billing price (confirmed by the US App Store monthly items $14.99/$35/$95). Yearly amounts are 12 x the billed-annually monthly price (144/336/912; page shows 'Save $36/$84/$228 per year' consistent with this) - the page does not print the yearly total itself. The top plan is now called 'Max' (formerly 'Unlimited'); App Store storefronts that list only 'Unlimited - Monthly' (DE, ID, PH) are mapped to Max.

services.name: Shopify
services.notes: Plan names as published: Basic, Grow, Advanced (Plus omitted: 'starts at' pricing, no fixed amount). Yearly amounts are the 'pay yearly' per-month rate x 12. The DE, MY, ID, PH and AE pricing pages quote USD (DE $39/$105/$399 monthly; MY/ID/PH $25/$65/$399 monthly, $19/$49/$299 yearly-rate; AE $32/$92/$399 monthly, $24/$69/$299 yearly-rate), so those countries are omitted under the local-currency rule.

services.name: Slack
services.notes: Prices are per user, list price (a 50%-off-for-3-months promo on monthly plans was ignored). Yearly amounts are the annual-billing monthly rate x 12 ($7.25 and $15 per user/month). Localised pages (en-in, en-gb, de-de, en-au, ja-jp, en-sg, en-ca) all showed USD prices, so only default/US are recorded.

services.name: Splice
services.notes: Web only, USD. Current plans are Sounds+ and Creator (no 'Creator+' price is published). Amounts come from the plan data embedded in splice.com/plans (display_name/billing_frequency/full_price in cents): Sounds+ monthly 1299 / annual 12999, Creator monthly 1999 / annual 19999. The rendered page shows Creator at $19.99/mo (with a $4.99 first-month promo) and Sounds+ at $12.99 with a 'Yearly save 15%' toggle. Yearly amounts are the annual charge.

services.name: Spotify
services.notes: All prices read from Spotify's official regional /premium/ pages. Spotify does not offer in-app purchase on iOS (US App Store listing has no IAP section), so only 'web' is recorded. In IN/ID/AE the single-account plan is called 'Premium Standard' and the multi-account plan 'Premium Platinum' (up to 3 accounts); Duo/Family are not sold there and Platinum carries no 'default'. Premium Lite was discontinued in IN/ID (per MediaNama, 2026-05) and is not listed on any page read. Prepaid 1-year Standard (IN Rs 799, AE AED 239) is a non-renewing one-year purchase, recorded as yearly without 'default'. Intro offers ignored; recurring prices recorded.

services.name: Squarespace
services.notes: Yearly amounts are the annual-billing monthly rate x 12 ($19/$29/$49/$99). Squarespace localises pricing by IP; the en-gb/en-au/en-ca/en-in subdomains returned 404 and de.squarespace.com showed USD, so only default/US are recorded.

services.name: Suno
services.notes: suno.com/pricing (USD) renders with the 'Annual save 20%' toggle: Pro '$8/month - Saves $24 by billing yearly', Premier '$24/month - Saves $72 by billing yearly'. Yearly web amounts = 12 x those (96 / 288). Monthly web amounts (10 / 30) are derived from the page's own 'saves' figures (96+24=120/yr => $10/mo; 288+72=360/yr => $30/mo) and match the US App Store monthly items ($10 / $30); treat as derived. iOS items ('Pro Plan', 'Premier Plan') are unlabeled: lower price mapped to monthly, ~10x price to yearly.
